stable.notes: Fixes blank Nia Solari, Elara Vale and Rowan Vale gallery previews. Thumbnails now load the idle filename and frame count together from each character's configuration. All four Jedi previews are pixel-checked. The approved 223-frame animation upgrade from 0.5.151, Miles Windu V15.4 and his 1.30x idle, custom art, selected character and saved size/speed settings are unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
